source: scratch github-discovery.json (3.8 MB raw) compacted; descriptions, topics, stars and licenses dropped
limitations: GitHub search is a changing index; totals moved during pagination.
pushed: reflects the latest push, so earlier-seen repos pushed again reappear; dedupe by node_id.
Name/description/readme text search does not cover every relevant repository.
No popularity filter or star sort; stars stored as archive-only metadata.
The collector recorded query-family membership per repository, not leaf-query membership; leaf ids and per-leaf counts are in coverage-ledger.json.

dedupe classes: node_id = matched a stored prior node ID; name_only = matched a prior full_name only (legacy records lack node IDs); notes_name = full_name appears only as text in notes.md; first_sighting = none of these.
Rows are metadata discovery, not code audits. Stars are omitted on purpose.

keyword_triage.selection: first-sighting repos with >=2 design-signal keyword hits in name/description; keyword triage, not quality ranking; stars not used
